name: Statsig MCP
description: Manages Statsig feature gates, experiments, dynamic configs and metrics from Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, so engineers can clean up stale flags and run A/B tests from chat.

skills.name: Feature Gates
skills.description: Lists, inspects, creates and updates feature gates with gate_read, gate_create and gate_update, so agents can find and remove stale gates.

skills.name: Experiments
skills.description: Lists, inspects, creates and updates A/B experiments with experiment_read, experiment_create and experiment_update, under project review rules.

skills.name: Dynamic Configs
skills.description: Reads, creates and replaces dynamic configs with dynamic_config_read, dynamic_config_create and dynamic_config_update, given write access.

skills.name: Metrics and Logs
skills.description: Inspects metrics, metric sources, audit logs and Logs Explorer data with metric_read and log_read to summarize console information in the IDE.

skills.name: Operation Discovery
skills.description: Finds and runs further operations such as layers, segments, holdouts and dashboards through discover_tools, api_read, api_write and api_destructive.
